verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents worldwide VAT/GST calculation, a supported-locations list, monitoring of potential registration obligations from past transactions, and registration on your behalf. A beta user confirms EU VAT is handled automatically from address and VAT numbers. Filing automation is documented only for US sales tax via TaxJar, and community reports say you still file and remit yourself, with UK/EU remittance described as a hassle. missing for 10: international (OSS/IOSS, UK, Canada, Australia) filing and remittance support, explicit OSS/IOSS scheme documentation, explicit foreign-threshold tracking detail per country, ongoing VIES re-validation.
